text:
maria: Hey @eli @jamie @sam — pinging you for eyes on PR #34901. It's a runtime routing + KMS key rotation change that needs runtime, infra, and sec approval before merge window. Diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/34901

eli: I'll take the runtime look. quick q — the main change is fallback routing thresholds + kv-cache TTL, right? can you paste the canary plan here?

maria: Yep — exactly. Canary plan: start at 5% traffic, ramp to 20% over 2h if no errors. rollback via feature flag. Basic commands in the runbook: ```kubectl -n inference set image deployment/runtime runtime=registry/redwood/runtime:pr-34901 && curl -X POST http://orchestrator/canary/start -d '{"pct":5}'```

jamie: infra: KMS key changes look OK at a glance but we need the audit-log config updated before production. do you have the KMS policy diff?

maria: Added the policy diff in the PR description — see lines 42-60. Also added IAM tweak to allow kms:Decrypt for the runtime service account.

sam: SRE: can you attach a quick latency baseline from staging (15m p50/p95) so we can compare during canary?

maria: Pasted a short summary: p50 48ms, p95 210ms, no obvious regressions vs previous. full test output in CI artifact: http://ci.internal/artifacts/34901/logs

security-bot: AUTO_CHECK: KMS policy change detected — manual security review required. Ticket created: SEC-2024-189. @sec-team please triage.

eli: I left 3 small nits on the PR about header propagation and context TTL. none of them are blocking, but worth fixing before wide canary.

jamie: added infra approval contingent on audit log config ticket (SEC-2024-189). left an LGTM.

sam: SRE + canary owner — fine with canary start tomorrow 10:00 PT. please publish the canary runbook and notify the oncall.

maria: Thanks — scheduling canary tomorrow 10:00 PT and will update PR with the runbook and rollback steps. tagging for final approves: @eli @jamie @sec-team :+1:
